# Files generated by harnesspm

- Text between `<!-- BEGIN:harnesspm` and `<!-- END:harnesspm -->`, sub-agent files in `.claude/agents/` and `.codex/agents/`, and other files that say they are generated by harnesspm are outputs. Never edit them.
- Links in `.claude/skills/`, `.claude/rules/` and `.agents/skills/` lead to the sources. Edit sources only under the `harnesspm-improve` skill.
- To change what an output says, find the source with `npx harnesspm why <ID>` and use the `harnesspm-improve` skill.
- After changing `harnesspm.json` or a harness file, run `npx harnesspm sync`.
